headline: Laureano Arcanio climbs to 30th on ARC-AGI-2

sections.text: Laureano Arcanio gained 21.94 points to reach 59.44, moving from 74th to 30th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The move puts Arcanio among the board’s top 30 as the contest’s public standings continue to shift.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
